scene_overview.short_description: A white-haired figure in god-form stands front and center, engulfed by a luminous aura that floods the lower third of the frame.
scene_overview.style: high-energy anime, divine glow on dark field
scene_overview.background_analysis: Upper two thirds: cool near-black field with drifting particles. Lower third: the subject's own luminous mist floods the frame edge to edge — no flat color can tile the page seamlessly.

canvas_analysis.rotation_reasoning: stored orientation matches scene content, no rotation cues found

motion_estimate.expected_movement: Aura flames flicker and swirl; mist at the feet churns; subject breathes.

color_calibration.palette_notes: Upper field is a cool near-black, B>R by ~6 points (#15161C-ish, corners measured #16161D/#15151B). The lower third is flooded by the subject's own bright mist (~#94969B at the bottom corners) reaching both frame edges, so no single flat fill works — complex. No embedded marks found.

background_layout.notes: Dark field + luminous mist flood + colored flame accents = 3+ blending tones. Blur mode; the blurred underlay absorbs the aura seamlessly.

top_zone.description: white hair + flame aura crown, inflated

middle_zone.description: torso, fists and smoke wisps, inflated

bottom_zone.description: legs + luminous mist flooding full width, cropped

safe_typography_zones.strategy_description: Top zone holds the face (hero detail) and the bottom zone is flooded edge-to-edge by the glow, so the pair anchors at the middle zone's narrow flanks; on wide viewports the page margins give them room.

equalizer_canvas_zone.notes: The mist reaches the bottom edge; overlap unavoidable, but the strip is bright and the bars stay readable.
